caption_draft:
6 Git commands you will use in every project.

git init — https://git-scm.com/docs/git-init — Creates an empty Git repository
git status — https://git-scm.com/docs/git-status.html — Shows the working tree status
git add — https://git-scm.com/docs/git-add — Adds file contents to the index
git commit — https://git-scm.com/docs/git-commit — Records changes to the repository
git log — https://git-scm.com/docs/git-log.html — Shows commit logs
git push — https://git-scm.com/docs/git-push — Updates the remote with your commits

Save this for your next project. Send it to a friend starting their first repo.

#git #github #coding #programming #firstyear #students #developer #notyourcollege

git-push - Update remote refs along with associated objects
